name: Martyrdom Unending
summary: When you are below half your maximum hit points, your Martyr’s Mercy restores an additional 1d6 hit points. You also have advantage on saving throws against psychic intimidation and corruption effects; you remain immune to the frightened condition while Unbroken Creed applies.
